recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見被膜下一大片淡粉紅色、細胞稀少的壞死區，周圍是保留的淋巴細胞，壞死區中已可看到零星深藍紫色不規則團塊；在年輕女性的無膿性壞死中找到 hematoxylin body，支持狼瘡淋巴結病。
features: Low-power lymph node with capsule at the upper right
Large, geographic, pale eosinophilic paracortical zone of necrosis with karyorrhectic debris
Scattered small irregular deep basophilic amorphous bodies within the necrotic zone
Surrounding preserved sheets of small lymphocytes with patent sinuses
Neutrophilic abscess formation and granulomas not evident at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a large geographic area of pale eosinophilic necrosis within the paracortex, bordered by preserved sheets of small lymphocytes, with the capsule seen at the upper right. Within the necrotic area are scattered karyorrhectic debris and irregular, deeply basophilic amorphous bodies consistent with hematoxylin bodies. There is no apparent abscess formation or granulomatous inflammation at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing lymphadenitis of systemic lupus erythematosus; higher power evaluation and immunostains are needed to exclude lymphoma and Kikuchi disease.

ddx.vs: Shares paracortical non-neutrophilic necrosis at low power, but hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells, and vasculitis favor lupus, supported by ANA/anti-dsDNA serology.
Viable tumor at the edge of necrosis consists of sheets of atypical cells with a clonal immunophenotype, not the small reactive lymphocytes seen here.
Infarction produces ghost outlines of the entire node with a peripheral granulation-tissue rim, rather than a focal paracortical necrosis with hematoxylin bodies.
These show caseating or stellate suppurative necrosis surrounded by palisading epithelioid histiocytes and neutrophils.
